raw:
@a1 assumed
  relation "pay the £15 for the class photo"
  role subject "at least 3"
  polarity affirmed
  basis implicature

@q query
  mode count
  select ?x
  where match
    relation "pay the £15 for the class photo"
    role subject ?x
    polarity affirmed
  end
  compare ?x equal ?count
  where all
    match
      role subject ?x
      polarity affirmed
    end
  end
